title: Channel
description: A chat in a messaging app (Telegram) linked to the workspace (ADR 0059). Watches that list it in `notify` send their events there, and people in the chat can ask about the cameras, as the channel's agent (its grants apply).

name.description: The chat's title, or the person's name for a private chat.

status.description: `blocked`: the bot was blocked or removed from the chat; link it again to use it.

snapshots.description: Send the event's snapshot with each alert. A snapshot sent to Telegram is stored by Telegram.

can_ask.description: Whether people in the chat can ask questions.

agent_id.description: The agent the chat asks as; its grants decide which cameras and senses answers use.
